completed.counterexample_details: Fix 0<alpha<1/2. On |z|<=1, |z^n-zprime^n|<=min(2,n|z-zprime|). Split the lacunary sum at 2^k|z-zprime|=1 to obtain |w(z)-w(zprime)|<=C|z-zprime|^alpha. Uniform convergence makes w continuous on the disk; uniform convergence of all differentiated series on smaller disks makes it harmonic and smooth inside. Orthogonality of the integer angular modes on radius R<1 gives integral_{|z|<R}|Dw|^2=pi*sum_k 2^((1-2alpha)k)*R^(2*2^k); monotone convergence as R tends to 1 makes this infinite. Set stationary u*=h_m=w, a=I, b=c=d=0, f=0, g=w, phi=w|boundary. The source theta condition holds for theta=1, all coefficient norms are finite, and residuals are identically zero. Thus the omitted individual energy membership is a real counterexample, not a source-dependent suspicion.
